This meme features a collage of four images showing the Tamil actor Dhanush performing identical high-kick fight choreography in different films, topped by a still from a movie where the actor stands opposite a character played by Vivek. This meme features a still from a Tamil film starring the popular comedian Vadivelu, who stands in the center wearing a bright yellow shirt while walking with his arms held out wide from his body, mimicking the exaggerated gait often adopted by gym-goers. This meme contrasts a classic jar of Brylcreem hair styling cream with a distressed man, using the juxtaposition to evoke a shared nostalgic experience among those who grew up in the 1990s. This meme features a still from a Tamil film showing the popular comedian Vadivelu, dressed in traditional attire with sacred ash on his forehead, gesturing emphatically with his hands while looking frustrated. This meme uses two screenshots from a classic Tamil movie to illustrate the potential embarrassment of having one's past social media activity scrutinized by the younger generation. The juxtaposition of the inquisitive, innocent child against the terrified, guilty-looking adult humorously highlights the fear of having one's digital history resurface, finished with a hashtag reminding the viewer to be careful with their online presence.

This meme captures a humorous play on words in Tamil, centered around a misunderstanding of a common shopping request. This meme features a humorous juxtaposition between the high cost of fresh produce and the marketing claims of household products. This meme features a still from a Tamil film starring the popular comedian Vadivelu, who stands on the left appearing to express exaggerated romantic distress while holding his chest with a dramatic facial expression.
